note: In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 18 states that priors do not depend on posteriors as posteriors depend on priors: for a prior/posterior pair the posterior depends on the prior and not conversely. The premise adds that this holds for simple priority (DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY) and that 'depend' is the counterfactual dependence for being of DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING; the passage speaks of priority in being generally and gives dependence no counterfactual analysis.
